packageRules.description: Automerge Helm chart patch and minor updates after 3 days and passing CI
Do not automerge 0.x minor bumps: pre-1.0 minors are potentially breaking (Renovate classifies them as minor by field position, so the rule above would otherwise catch them)
Cilium: one group with the Terraform bootstrap pin in terraform-talos-cluster (same groupName there), so both bumps share a branch name. Not automerged: the bootstrap pin must be bumped in step.

ArgoCD chart: one group with the Terraform bootstrap pin in terraform-talos-cluster (same groupName there), so both bumps share a branch name. Not automerged: the bootstrap pin must be bumped in step.

Gateway API CRDs: one group with the Terraform bootstrap pin in terraform-talos-cluster (same groupName there), so both bumps share a branch name. Not automerged: the bootstrap pin must be bumped in step.
